purpose: Domain-neutral perception layer that converts browser and system context into provenance-preserving observations for downstream decision analysis.

tenant_boundary.rule: company_id is the sole canonical tenant/company boundary. Legacy tenant identifiers must be normalized before observation construction and never act as independent boundaries.

authority_rule: Observation Engine may observe, normalize, classify and derive evidence-bearing signals. It MUST NOT grant authority, execute actions, or produce a DecisionPacket recommendation.
invariants: Every observation has exactly one company_id.
Raw source facts remain distinguishable from normalized and derived values.
Every derived claim references its supporting evidence or source fields.
Confidence expresses perception quality, not permission or recommendation strength.
Decision-subject observations identify a question requiring evaluation; they do not answer it.
Opportunities and problems are candidates for downstream evaluation, not automatic recommendations.
Observation IDs are immutable; corrections/supersession create new revisions.
Browser-origin observations record page/frame context without treating page content as trusted authority.
System-origin observations record provider/system identity and stable external references where available.
No execution command may be embedded in an observation.
downstream_relationship: Observation outputs may be transformed into DecisionPacket evidence/subjects/options by later decision stages, subject to provenance and authority rules.
